qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Four-player Canadian wireless price war, CRTC wholesale unbundling mandates, and continuous capital intensity keep ROIC depressed around 4-5% (far below the 12% hurdle), leading to mobile ARPU deflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC 4-5% vs 12% hurdle; wireless ARPU deflation and ongoing multi-operator discounting strip TELUS of pricing power).
qualitative.evidence: TELUS generates a multi-year ROIC of ~4-5%, failing the 12% hurdle rate. Mobile phone ARPU declined from $60.52 (2024) to $58.67 (2025) under aggressive promotional competition from Rogers, Bell, and Quebecor/Freedom Mobile. Combined with continuous DRIP share dilution, net debt exceeding CAD 27B, and high capex intensity, the economic engine fails to earn economic profits.
